# Command reference

Every command and query the engine registers (145 in total), generated from the registry. The full JSON Schemas are in `schema/commands.json` and `schema/queries.json`.

MCP exposure: `core` commands are always listed as tools (`item.move` is `item_move`), `catalog` ones are reachable through the catalog tools, `hidden` ones are not exposed.
